selection_note: FD: A6 was the best arm of the A0-A7 chain under the frozen protocol (test best on both datasets; val_fc best on FD004, tied best on FD002). N-CMAPSS: validation has only 2 independent units and the tuning grid showed its val_fc ranking disagrees with test; the cross-dataset stable configuration t3 (d32+wd, 'ncmapss_tune/t3_d32_wd') is locked as the engineering default for both DS03 and DS08a. Consequence: the t3 test numbers in results_v3 (DS03 9.27/13.17, DS08a 10.94/13.39) are post-hoc and must be re-estimated on fresh seeds/splits before being claimed as validated results. The val_fc-discipline alternatives (DS03 t5_d32_mean val_fc 4.74, DS08a t0_default val_fc 5.38 but worst test RMSE in the grid) are recorded here as provenance.

FD002.protocol: engine-grouped split (split_seed=0), grouped min/max scaler, train cap=125, fixed_cuts endpoint validation, test = one final window per engine on raw RUL, evaluated once

FD004.protocol: engine-grouped split (split_seed=0), grouped min/max scaler, train cap=125, fixed_cuts endpoint validation, test = one final window per engine on raw RUL, evaluated once

DS03.protocol: unit-cycle mean (X_s only, T excluded), unit-grouped dev split (split_seed=0), global z-score scaler, no cap, A6 + patch_cnn stem (runner-hardcoded), fixed_cuts endpoint validation, test = fixed_cuts mid-life endpoints on official test units, evaluated once (NASA not reported)
DS03.caveat: selection signal unreliable (2 val units); treat test numbers as post-hoc until re-validated on fresh seeds or resplits

DS08a.protocol: unit-cycle mean (X_s only, T excluded), unit-grouped dev split (split_seed=0), global z-score scaler, no cap, A6 + patch_cnn stem (runner-hardcoded), fixed_cuts endpoint validation, test = fixed_cuts mid-life endpoints on official test units, evaluated once (NASA not reported)
DS08a.provenance: results_v3/ncmapss_tune/t3_d32_wd/DS08a/seed_0 (post-hoc; val_fc alternative t0_default rejected: best val_fc but worst test RMSE in the grid, 18.07)
DS08a.caveat: selection signal unreliable (2 val units); treat test numbers as post-hoc until re-validated on fresh seeds or resplits
